data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_277)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you can use arcane eye three times per day as a spell-like ability. The arcane eye you summon functions as if you had cast arcane sight and were able to view its information through the arcane eye. This allows you to see magical auras through the arcane eye, and potentially identify the schools of magic involved. You can also potentially determine the spellcasting or spell-like abilities of viewed creatures, as noted in the spell description.
